proof_body:
by
  intro a b hab
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hab.ne'
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hab.ne'
  have key : 1 / a - 1 / b = (b - a) / (a * b) := by
    field_simp
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 := div_pos (sub_pos.2 h) hab
    linarith
  · intro h
    have h2 : 0 < (b - a) / (a * b) := by
      rw [← key]
      linarith
    have h3 := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hab).1 h2
    linarith
